name: tinylittleoffice
description: A tiny office suite that lives entirely in the URL.

scripts.build: node scripts/network-doc.ts && npm run -s lint && vite build && vite build -c vite.api.config.ts --logLevel warn && node scripts/budgets.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run -s tinier:types && tsc -p tinier && npm run -s media:types && tsc -p media
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit && prettier --check . && vitest run --project unit test/lints.test.ts test/stylesheets.test.ts test/scroll.test.ts
scripts.walks: VITE_WALK_STEPS=200 VITE_WALK_RUNS=2 VITE_WALK_FRESH=1 vitest run --project browser test/browser/walks.test.ts
scripts.tinier:schema: wrangler d1 execute tinier -c tinier/wrangler.jsonc --remote --file=tinier/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute tinier -c tinier/wrangler.jsonc --remote --file=tinier/migrations/0001-brakes.sql
scripts.tinier:dev: wrangler d1 execute tinier -c tinier/wrangler.jsonc --local --file=tinier/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute tinier -c tinier/wrangler.jsonc --local --file=tinier/migrations/0001-brakes.sql && wrangler dev -c tinier/wrangler.jsonc --port 8787 --var SITE:${SITE:-http://localhost:4178}
